lead: Procedure station on a birthing model: conduct a normal delivery and the third stage, talking to the mother; often followed by an episiotomy and its repair.
f: Crowning: keep the head flexed, guard the perineum · head out slowly between contractions · feel for cord round the neck · wait for restitution · anterior shoulder down, posterior up · baby onto the mother · AMTSL

sc: Tight cord around the neck → Clamp twice and cut
Head retracts, no restitution → Shoulder dystocia: HELPERR

f: Consent, chaperone · empty bladder · wash, gown, sterile gloves · delivery set: 2 artery forceps, cord scissors, episiotomy scissors, cord clamps · oxytocin 10 IU drawn up · resuscitaire warm
Primigravida up to 2 h, multipara 1 h of active pushing · FHR every 5 min · push only with contractions; pant at crowning
Dry, warm, skin to skin · Apgar at 1 and 5 min (≥ 7 normal) · golden minute: breathing by 60 s, else ventilate · breastfeed within 1 h

Exclude a second twin · oxytocin 10 IU IM (thigh) within 1 min · none: misoprostol 600 µg oral · delayed cord clamping 1–3 min · controlled cord traction with counter-pressure · uterine tone checks every 15 min, rub up only if soft · check placenta and membranes complete

tr: Pulling the cord without a contraction or counter-pressure → inversion

f: Only for a reason (not routine) · mediolateral, 60° from the midline at crowning · lidocaine 1% spread along the line (max 3 mg/kg) · two fingers protect the head · equals a 2nd-degree tear

sc: Head crowning, perineum about to tear badly → Mediolateral episiotomy

f: 1st: skin · 2nd: perineal muscle · 3a: < 50% of external sphincter · 3b: > 50% · 3c: internal sphincter · 4th: rectal mucosa · 3rd and 4th repaired in theatre

sc: More than 50% of the external sphincter torn → 3b: repair in theatre

f: First stitch 1 cm above the apex · vaginal lining continuous to the hymen · muscle · skin subcuticular · rapid polyglactin 2-0 · PR and swab count after
